title: A particle reinforced NbTaTiV refractory high entropy alloy based composite with attractive mechanical properties
process_description: prepared by mixing high purity (>99.5 wt.%) Nb, Ta, Ti, and V powders in equiatomic composition, ball milling for 12 h at 250 rpm in argon atmosphere, adding 4 wt.% stearic acid, and consolidating via spark plasma sintering at 1500°C with a heating rate of 100°C/min, held for 30 min under 30 MPa pressure in pure argon atmosphere.
